summary: Frontend-only testing of Treesh wallet + accent sync for Ebonics. All 13 required scenarios verified. (1) Fresh with treesh_stars={points:500} + welcome bonus => header shows 650 and treesh_stars.points=650 with 'Ebonics · Welcome bonus' a=150 log entry; reload keeps 650 (walletLinked flag prevents double bonus). (2) No treesh_stars at all => wallet created with points=150. (3) Migration from existing ebonics_save_v1 (starlites=400) with treesh_stars.points=100 => wallet becomes 500 with first log 'Ebonics · Balance moved to Treesh wallet' a=400. (4) Live parent sync: second page in same context mutates treesh_stars (+1000) => header on first page updates to 1500 without reload via storage event. (5) Daily claim +60 updates treesh_stars.points via applyToWallet and prepends 'Ebonics · Daily drop · day 1' entry. (6) Shop theme purchase deducts exact price from treesh_stars.points and adds 'Ebonics · Bought <name>' log entry (delta -200 for a 200-price theme when achievements already unlocked). (7) Insufficient funds blocks purchase (wallet unchanged, error toast). (8) Fresh wallet value enforcement: when 2nd page lowers points to 1 after shop loaded with 5000, buy attempt fails and wallet stays at 1 (buy() uses readWallet() at the moment of purchase, not stale state). (9) Profile wallet cells: wallet-treesh=777, wallet-ebonics-earned=1,234, wallet-spent=75 computed from local starLog, and ebonics_starlites localStorage=='1234' (lifetime earned). (10) Accent treesh_accent='"#9328ff"' sets --eb-gold=#9328ff and --eb-on-gold=#FFFFFF; quick-play-btn renders rgb(147,40,255) background with white text. (11) Live accent change from second page to '#34d399' updates --eb-gold immediately and --eb-on-gold flips to #0B0914 (luminance-based contrast). (12) Shop accent-sync-toggle: aria-checked='true' by default when accent present; toggling off reverts --eb-gold to theme default #FFC72C and persists after reload; toggling back on reapplies accent. (13) Toggle disabled (opacity 40%, cannot click) when no treesh_accent in storage. Regression: themes purchase/equip work; onboarding, nav still OK (previously validated in iteration 2).
critical_code_review_comments: store.js applyToWallet() uses Math.max(0, points+delta) which silently clamps negative balances. If a buy() ever slipped past the readWallet guard (e.g. race with parent app writing a smaller value between the check and the write), the user would get the item for free. Consider aborting the write if resulting points would be negative instead of clamping.

store.js commit() replays queued _pending entries into applyToWallet() by summing deltas and prepending the reversed list; because this is done in a single localStorage write it is non-transactional versus concurrent parent-app writes. For low-frequency actions this is fine but worth noting if the parent app writes aggressively.

readAccent() accepts both JSON-stringified '"#rrggbb"' and raw '#rrggbb' / 'rrggbb' — good. Short-hex (#abc) and rgb() formats are silently ignored (returns null) which disables the toggle — acceptable per spec.
ebonics_starlites is written on every state change as String(state.totalEarned); fine, but it will never shrink even if the save is cleared via other means — intended as lifetime stat, documented.
seed_data_creation: All seeding via in-browser localStorage: treesh_stars, treesh_profile, treesh_accent, ebonics_save_v1. No backend writes. No new leaderboard entries (score=0 skipped).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Shared wallet keys: treesh_stars (JSON {points, log:[{t,a,r}]}), treesh_accent (JSON string of hex or raw hex), treesh_profile. Ebonics save: ebonics_save_v1 (has walletLinked flag to prevent re-migrating/re-welcome-bonusing, useAccent for toggle, totalEarned for lifetime). Lifetime earned also mirrored in ebonics_starlites localStorage. Storage events fire only in OTHER documents, so use context.new_page() + goto(same-origin URL) + evaluate(localStorage.setItem...) to simulate parent-app writes; the Ebonics tab must be brought to front afterwards so React picks up (storage event still fires in background tabs though).
